product_metadata.title: Cilio 18/10 Stainless Steel Wine Sealer
features: KEEPS WINE FRESH LONGER: There is nothing more disappointing than discovering that your delicious bottle of wine has lost flavor due to oxidation. When you need an easy way to safeguard your high quality wines, it's time to try the Cilio Stainless Steel Wine Sealer, the wine bottle topper and sealer that really seals your bottles airtight.

SUPERIOR QUALITY BOTTLE SEALER: This stainless steel wine bottle sealer has been manufactured in the German tradition of the Cilio brand. Made with a brushed stainless steel shell, it is built to deliver a leak-proof seal every time. This bottle stopper will become one of your favorite wine accessories. As beautiful as it is functional, you'll wonder how you ever got along without it!

LEAK-PROOF SIDE STORAGE: The Cilio wine bottle sealer's sealing mechanism allows you to store wine in the fridge without worrying about mess or leaking. The airtight seal is designed to be 100% leak-proof, even when the bottle is lying down. Aside from the side storage convenience, the flat top ensures that your bottles will still fit perfectly in your wine refrigerator

EASY TO USE: Our bottle sealer is quick and uncomplicated for busy people who don’t want to fuss with difficult sealers. Simply place the wine sealer over the top of your unfinished bottle and pull the sealer down over the bottle opening until it snaps in place, providing a leak-proof seal. When you are ready to have your next glass of wine, just press down on the sealer's top button and remove. It’s that easy!

CILIO TRADITION OF QUALITY: Cilio, a partner of Frieling for more than two decades, is well known for making quality tabletop, serving, and bar accessories. They place great emphasis on combining timeless design and functionality to bring you the highest quality products, and this philosophy of greatness runs throughout their entire product line.
